text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There are girls with better track records 
than me, and girls with stronger finishing 
kicks than me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to win...! I want to win and stand 
center stage!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm off! Keep your eyes on my running, 
okay?
